text:
sam: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands  capturing the Qs we promised to answer + owners. Ill keep this editable; ping me for edit access.

priya: Thanks. Can you confirm whether Dedicated GA is gated on any contract/legal review?

sam: Not for core GA. Contracts team will run a standard template for enterprise deals; no blocker for GA. Owner for contract templates: @jen.

noah: About the latency dashboards  will customers see p50/p95 per-model by default?

sam: Console will show p50/p95 + token breakdown per model in the next Console patch. Beta rollout to a subset of customers in 2 weeks. Owner: @caroline to coordinate rollout list.

jen: For contracts, Ill produce a short checklist for sales (SLA summary, data residency options, support tiers). ETA: 10 business days.

priya: Re: routing policy question from the live Qs  any interim API to set basic rules before the UI lands?\nsam: Yes  there is a config endpoint in the API (alpha). Well share docs tomorrow. API owner: @noah. Example request snippet to set a simple region preference: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.company/v1/policies \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \n  -d '{"name":"prefer-us","type":"region","value":"us-*"}'
```

noah: Ill post the API docs + example to #eng-api and attach to the Console issue.

caroline: Small ask from PMs  can we get a one-paragraph blurb for the product changelog about "cost-aware controls"? Something customer-ready.

sam: Yep. Ill draft a blurb and share it for edits.

infra-bot: Canary run started: infra/canary-2026-03-25 in eu-west-1. Logs: https://infra.redwood/canaries/2026-03-25/infra-canary-1

jen: Also, legal asked for the data flow diagram for private deployments. @caroline can you attach the diagram or point to the repo?

caroline: Diagram lives in the docs repo: https://git.redwood/docs/tree/main/diagrams/private-dataflow.svg. Ill copy it to the legal thread.

priya: One more from sales: how do customers request Dedicated during GA?

sam: Customers should open a request via the sales intake form (link on the Console request page) or email sales@redwood.company. Ill add a tiny "How to request Dedicated" section to the slides.

noah: Follow-up on evals: will Optimize include nightly regression runs or only on-demand?

sam: Both. Nightly quick-checks for flagged prompt sets + on-demand full evals. Leah will run the initial eval set in beta. Owner: @priya to coordinate with Leah.

priya: Ill loop Leah in and schedule a short kickoff.

sam: Action summary (owners + rough ETA):
- Jen: contracts checklist for sales (ETA 10 business days)
- Caroline: Console rollout list + dataflow diagram to legal (ETA 1 week)
- Noah: policy API docs + example (ETA tomorrow)
- Priya: coordinate Optimize eval beta kickoff with Leah (ETA next week)
- Sam: add Dedicated request blurb to slides and post updated slide deck (ETA 48h)

sam: Links from today:
- Slides: https://redwood.company/internal/slides/all-hands-2026-03.pdf
- Recording: https://video.redwood/internal/ah-2026-03 (internal only)

caroline: small edit request: can the slides include a single-line "who to contact for Dedicated" (cc: sales@redwood.company)?

sam: Done  Ill update and repost.
